description: Behavior-preserving prep for fz-bin.5. Native lowering currently handles BackendTail::DirectCall inline inside NativeLowerer::lower_entry_tail (src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs around the DirectCall arm), including callee resolution, arg lane encoding, return-flow routing, and continuation construction. Multi-target call edges need to emit that same direct-call body once per dispatch arm. Extract the single-target lowering into small helpers first, with no artifact shape changes and no behavior changes, so fz-bin.5 can call the helper from each selected arm instead of duplicating the inline block. Verify cargo check/test coverage stays green and direct-call backend/native shape tests still pass.
title: Compiler2 native: extract direct-call tail lowering before multi-target call edges
